active_provenance.qc_flag_origin: Derived validity/count checks on returned measurements, not independent instrument QC.
active_provenance.required_stations_policy: Preserves supplied package minimum50; NOT a KMA API QC flag.
active_provenance.source_policy: Fresh KMA API Hub station-date observations; source values > -90 for temperature; RN_DAY=-9 maps to zero following kmahub; other negative rain values excluded and audited. Daily equal-weight means of actual valid contributors, minimum50, no imputation or 62/n scaling.
